title: Add Synthesis as Optional Terminal Phase
summary: Adds Synthesis as an optional terminal phase to the RDD pipeline, implemented as a new skill (/rdd-synthesize), extending the pipeline to RESEARCH → PRODUCT DISCOVERY → MODEL → DECIDE → ARCHITECT → BUILD → [SYNTHESIS]. Synthesis runs after BUILD (or after whichever phase terminates the current pipeline run) and requires a substantial artifact trail as prerequisite; unlike the pipeline's gates it is not bounded by Invariant 4's 5-10 minute-per-gate cost — the agent conversation (journey review, novelty surfacing, framing) is bounded at roughly 30-60 minutes, and the essay itself is written by the user outside the pipeline on their own time. Deliverables are an outline co-produced within the pipeline and a synthesis essay written afterward in the user's own voice.
workflow_point: new optional terminal phase after BUILD
mechanism: new /rdd-synthesize skill: 30-60 minute conversation plus user-authored essay outside the pipeline
